critique: Flawless execution across all industrial design and photographic criteria. The vertical rectangular monolith housing, 9 upper radial tick marks with a completely blank bottom arc, exact beach typography, lower semicircular sub-dial, and single burnt-orange hands are 100% faithful to the reference. The warm, atmospheric hi-fi credenza setting with the brushed-aluminum turntable and glowing vacuum tube amplifier delivers exceptional magazine-grade art direction.
